system.summary: 1520-21: homophonic substitution of about 49 invented signs for Italian letters, no word division, a null filler sign; 1519: a two-tier sign cipher; Cistarelli: two-digit figure cipher.
system.notes: Key values for the 1520-21 cipher in targets/caprile1519/key21.json (majority) and key21_counts.json.

prior_solution.where: 1882 decipherments filed with nos. 3-8 and 10 (Vestigia); Somogyi 2025 for R1138; none for R1136, R1139, R1137, R1128

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE R1126-R1140 metadata and images; Vestigia searches Caprile (52) and Cistarelli (20); contact sheets.
Vestigia: 1519 cipher originals filed as 'a' with 'b'/'c' clear copies; ASMo inventory dates them to 1882. R1129-R1135 read at the time or in 1882.
Somogyi 2025 (Scriptorium VI) prints decipherments of the 16 Feb 1521 postscript (R1138 and V1920).
Two subagents transcribed R1137 (667 signs) and the 1520-21 sign cipher in five texts (2,278 signs, 49 labels).
Monotone EM alignment of V1920 against Somogyi's text from a uniform start.
Ciphertext-only homophonic anneal over the 1520-21 corpus with a 16th-c. Italian 4-gram model and a unigram penalty; fragments like scritti, regno, Ungaria.
EM alignment seeded by the anneal key: 714 letters aligned on V1920 and R1138, 90% consistent; homophonic key.
Key applied to R1139 and R1136: phrases read (il custode, tornato governator, deli danari del suo, voler andar in Italia; questo episcopato, de Ungaria, tal debito).
Ciphertext-only anneal on Cistarelli's R1137 with consensus fixing; phrases only (lettere per, presto, non se poteria, dua milla).

R1128's 1519 two-tier system: R1133 transcribed in full (1327 columns) and aligned with its 1882 decipherment 7c; one letter per column, homophonic (c/7=o, m/n=r, x/7=t ...); bracket-L signs are nomenclator words ([d][s][&] = de vostra maesta).
Language-model anneal over the 1519 columns with 9 fixed values; R1128 (21% code words) not read.

R1139 second pass for the quotation list (30 Sept): signs re-checked on the image, three transcription errors corrected, key21 counts + it-cinquecento beam search proposals checked sign by sign; L05-L07 now continuous ('li go fato moto deli danari del suo de[b]ito, come mi dise messere [Alfonso]. Lui m'ha resposto, dice de voler andar in Italia'), L08-L09 in phrases; L01-L03 still phrases (r1139_pass2.txt).

Vestigia records of the Caprile/Cistarelli files listed for the cipher flag ('titkosirás'): only V1853, V1874, V1876, V1919-V1922; no further letter uses the 1520-21 key. V1921 (no. 12) was the only one never reported as read.
V1921's six cipher runs re-checked sign by sign on v1921_2.jpg: L01 'z t' is one crossed z (z+), L02 'm p' is m+ with a looped descender, L03 'x t' is x+, L04 HH is ff; 166 signs (v1921_signs.txt).
Mechanical decrypt with key21.json treating the lone o as a null (decrypt21_raw.txt) gave only 'ogni cosa', 'il custode', 'Agria era data', 'suo signore'.

Lone o as a null ruled out: context forces o = h ('ha', 'ch'a', 'che') and o = u ('qui', 'suo', 'quantunque'), matching the EM counts (o 28, h 13, u 10) and V1920 'che' = PHI o y; oo = b ('beni', R1139 'debito'); z+ = q and x+ = q; EL = f ('oficio'); K = et (M).

V1921 read in context: 'il custode e stato quel ch'a persuaso ... a dire che Agria era data d'anti il suo advento, e[t] che lo toglia in oficio ... suo signore ... sopra soi beni, quantunque siano in reg[no]'. 160/166 signs read as sense (96.4 %, 88.0 % at grade C); 6 unread (two minims, two stray signs, two at the torn edge).
it-cinquecento order-5 model: reading -1.79 per char, the same letters shuffled with word breaks kept -4.12 (20 runs); best_language ranks it-modern first.
Grade-M words not resolved: 'dicixe' (L01, disse?) and 'revelta' (L02, rivela?); 'regno' at the page edge not legible.
R1136 L10 'x p a ss m+ f o/o' = questo shows x + looped p is one q-sign (xp); V1921 L06 'quantunque' then needs no stray sign: 161/166 (97.0 %).

beam21.py: beam decoder over key21_counts priors plus the V1921 values (lone o = h/u/null, oo = b, z+/x+ = q, EL/AMP = p/f, K = t/et), it-cinquecento order 5 without spaces, off-key letters allowed at a penalty and flagged; run on R1139 and R1136 (beam21_out.txt).

R1139 pass 3: phrases checked on the crops and regraded; 'debito' now at key values (oo = b), 'gubernator', 'messer Alfonso', 'Agria in o[f]icio'; 83.8 % of decoded letters inside claimed phrases (regrade21.py), mostly M; L01 and L03 still phrase-level.

R1136 pass 3: 'transferse a Buda il custode', 'in oficio questo episcopato, et a epso custode', 'dicono esser conclusi', 'potra far al custo[d]e per questa via de Ungaria sopra il suo', 'in questo loco niente', 'tal debito'; 59.4 % inside claimed phrases; crops disagree with the single transcription in L03, L05-L08.

Known keys on R1128 (knownkeys.py): pairX syllabary from R1130/4c covers 32 % of columns, LM -3.22 vs -3.24 for a random key with the same values; fixed1519 covers 13 %; key1519_ann is fitted on R1128 (no evidence).
Known keys for R1137: key21, the 1519 tables, Bonzagni 1512-14, Sadoleto 1482 and Maffeo 1489 are sign alphabets; DECODE harvest lists no Este/ASMo key 1490-1550; no numeric key to apply.

R1137 ciphertext-only anneal (fastanneal, order 4, 6 x 60k) against the same tokens shuffled: -2.69 vs -3.05 per token, so there is language signal, but the output gives only fragments ('auan[ti]', 'edirit[o]'); not read.
R1137 P1, P3, P4 viewed at overview scale (the transcription had not checked them): P1 and P3 clear text, P4 address; cipher only on P2.

R1136 second transcription from the original image at native resolution (r1136_pass4.txt): 11 of 12 lines changed, e.g. L03 TH -> lone o, CE x p -> c xp; L05 'U? K m t o SL o f QB n f QB QB' -> 'U q f B QB B n t QB'; L04/L06 o+ (crossed lone o).

R1136 pass 4: new values o+ = s, D = b/x, plain c = o; new phrases 'Lactantio, ho inteso, qual', 'congregati ... Bachiensis, che ogni episcopa-', 'l'altro in titolo, et a questo modo excludera', 'vostra Excelentia, quel si-'; 66.9 % of decoded letters inside claimed phrases (was 59.4 %).

R1139 second pass on the unread stretches at native resolution (r1139_pass4.txt): Z+ = q 'quando', Zp = q 'qual', xp 'quel'; L01 'il custode, quando a Buda, come i' scrisi, e tornato gubernator de', L03 'credo dia ogni ato e qualche cosa a le ma[n] di [l]o custode; per anchora si n'e in-', L09 've ne daro; vedro quel mi dara, e il tuto [re]portaro'; 88.7 % (was 83.8 %). Open: numeral-like '4 8 1 7', '1 7'.

R1128: factorised syllabary (column = consonant of the upper sign + vowel of the base) trained by hard EM on R1130/4c and R1133/7c (syl_fact.py); base tier learns cleanly (7 = none, m = e, n = o) but the upper tier does not (most uppers map to '' as often as to a consonant); R1128 beam decode scores LM -2.92/char against -2.41 for the same tables permuted, i.e. worse than the control: not read.

R1137 P2 spot-check of L04-L07 against the image (autocontrast bands, native resolution): 13 of 92 groups read differently from r1137_transcription.txt (85/95, 45/95, 0/5/6, 80/86, group boundaries); the full 584-group re-check was not completed because the image does not settle these digits.

R1137 crib test (r1137_crib.py, ORDER 5, 20 restarts base, 4 windows x 3 restarts x 80k per word, word-level segmentation rerank): cribs custode, agria, alfonso, debito, buda, episcopato give anneal gains -57 to -348 (mean -169), six control words -49 to -363 (mean -172); best word score is a control. No crib lands.
R1139 '4 8 1 7' and '1 7' tested as letters with no prior (beam drops them) and as numerals ('gubernator de 4817', '17'): no date, sum or word fits; graded as code groups with no code list.

Look-alike sign tabulation over R1136, R1139, V1920, R1138, V1921 (lookalike21.py): CE = o (55/72), xp = q (6/6) accepted; c (o5 e4 c3), QB vs 8, AMP vs EL (EL p8 d7) show no consistent split; R1136 re-decoded with the union priors: no new phrase.

Name and phrase cribs (namecrib21.py): Vestigia people (Dragfi, Batthyany, Montelini, Perenyi), offices, places and all of Somogyi's R1138/V1920 phrases against R1136/R1139 windows; only already-read words fit; no new placement.
R1139 L08 'mi per Milan'; R1139 measured 89.7 % (453/505), R1136 66.9 % (378/565) of decoded letters inside claimed phrases (regrade21.py).

Pen-shape step (shapes21.py): blob segmentation aligned to tokens crops QB correctly in 13/31 cases, EL 1/8, 8 0/3; QB has two forms (figure-8, stem with cross-bar) but the LM value per occurrence does not follow the form; plain c is a distinct form with no consistent value; no shape class carries a value, so no re-decode; R1139 89.7 %, R1136 66.9 % unchanged.

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The 1520-21 homophonic key was rebuilt by EM-aligning the ciphertext of V1920 and R1138 with W. Somogyi's printed decipherments (Scriptorium VI, 2025), seeded by a ciphertext-only anneal, and then used to read R1139 and R1136 in part and V1921 (2 Oct 2026, 97.0 %); R1129-R1135 were already read (1882 clear copies) and R1128/R1137 stay open.
outcome.notes: Key verified by reproducing Somogyi's plaintext (90% of aligned signs). R1139 and R1136 read in part; R1128 and R1137 open. fraction_read estimated from the notes (R1139 and R1136 phrases only, R1137 fragments, R1128 unread; R1129-R1135, R1138 read by others), not measured. key partial: the 1520-21 sign key is rebuilt (89.6% on Somogyi's cribs) but R1128's two-tier system and R1137's numeric key are not. R1138 marked read (Somogyi 2025). V1921 (no. 12, not on DECODE) read 2 Oct 2026: 161/166 signs (97.0 %), read_v1921.md; lone o = h/u, oo = b, z+/x+ = q added to the key. Pass 3 (2 Oct 2026, pass3_r1136_r1139.md): R1139 83.8 %, R1136 59.4 % of decoded letters inside claimed phrases. Pass 4 (2 Oct 2026): R1136 66.9 %, R1139 88.7 %; R1128 factorised rebuild failed; R1137 crib test negative, transcription noise 14 %. Pass 5 (3 Oct 2026): R1139 89.7 %, R1136 66.9 %; look-alike tabulation and crib tests in pass3_r1136_r1139.md.

outcome.fraction_read_source: NOTES prose, not measured: decrypt21_raw.txt gives a key value to 97-98% of signs of R1139/R1136 (only ? unread), but the output is garbled by transcription errors and reads only in phrases, so the value-assigned share is not the share that reads; R1137 and R1128 have no reading file.
